task: Adversarial-review fix: WaveformTapeMinimap was fed a stale/wrong peak source for the common under-cap case (CRITICAL, found during the audio_player_completion_004 plan's adversarial review)

frontend/src/app/layout/WaveformTape.tsx.summary: `minimapPeaks` now reads `peakArray` (usePeaks' already-resolved effective source) instead of the raw `peaks` prop. Previously, when PlayerBar passed `peaks={null}` (every under-cap clip, since sidecarPeaks is only non-null over the duration cap), `peaks !== undefined` was true and the minimap rendered flat placeholder bars instead of the real decoded shape, even though the tape canvas correctly showed it.

flow_impact: The minimap now correctly shows the real waveform shape for under-cap clips (the common case), matching the tape canvas, instead of a flat fallback strip.
